title: Netflix renews Nobody Wants This for a fourth season
summary: The Kristen Bell and Adam Brody comedy was picked up two weeks after its third season began.
body:
Netflix has renewed the romantic comedy Nobody Wants This, starring Kristen Bell and Adam Brody, for a fourth season.

The renewal was announced on 6 November, about two weeks after the third season arrived on 22 October. The Hollywood Reporter said that season had the biggest opening week of any returning Netflix comedy this year.

What we know

The new season will again be made in Los Angeles. No release date has been announced.

The show's co-showrunners, Erin Foster, Jenni Konner and Bruce Eric Kaplan, said they were thrilled by the news.

Sources: Variety, The Hollywood Reporter, TVLine.
